# 01 - Clause-by-clause compliance matrix

**Status: DRAFT_FOR_OWNER_REVIEW.** Generated by `docs/bid/package/build_package.py` from `docs/bid/package/compliance_data.py` and the registered RFP clauses at the bid freeze commit `bbc480c` (`bbc480cd6aacaa40c39eb459a056b942fe996b32`); do not edit by hand. Machine-readable: `docs/bid/package/compliance_matrix_v1.json`.

Tender 2026_DRDO_788433_1, RFP DTDF/06/13516/DSP/ABEP/X/L/M/01. Clause text is the repository's verbatim transcription (`docs/requirements/rfp_official/rfp_registration_v1.json`, 37 clauses, pages 16-21, 27, 30). Every evidence path below is a file at `bbc480c`; read it with `git show bbc480c:<path>`. Locators are JSON pointers (with `[key=value]` list selection) or section names.

Statuses never claim more than the evidence shows. At the freeze no RVM row of the flight configuration is PASS (27 NOT_EVALUATED, 3 INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE), the Hall credible transport set is empty and every absolute 0-D Hall result is withdrawn; this matrix quotes none of them.

## Status vocabulary

| status | meaning |
|---|---|
| COMPLY | the offered design, as recorded at bbc480c, already meets the clause as written (a property of the offer; no test result is implied) |
| COMPLY_PLANNED_WITH_EVIDENCE_PATH | Vyovrinda proposes to comply; the repository at bbc480c holds the plan / verification path (file + locator); nothing is yet demonstrated |
| PARTIAL | some sub-items have a plan or evidence path at bbc480c, others have none yet (listed in the response) |
| NOT_YET_DEMONSTRATED | a technical performance requirement whose outcome depends on hardware / validation evidence that does not exist at bbc480c; the programme has a path, but the package must not claim the outcome |
| OWNER_INPUT_REQUIRED | the response depends on organisational, commercial or design-authority information that the repository does not hold; the owner must supply it |

## Clause responses

### RFP-P16-01 (p. 16, Part III 1(A)i) - COMPLY_PLANNED_WITH_EVIDENCE_PATH

> RFP (verbatim transcription): 1. Development of Air Breathing Electric Propulsion (ABEP) which will work in the VLEO environment. 2. Testing and space qualification of the Air Breathing Electric Propulsion (ABEP).

**Response.** Vyovrinda proposes to develop, test and space-qualify an ABEP system for VLEO. The programme is hardware-first (owner pivot 2026-09-27, A9.21 hardware order); the development and test plan (03_DEVELOPMENT_AND_TEST_PLAN.md) maps it onto Milestones 1-5. No part of the system is yet demonstrated: at bbc480c all 30 RVM rows of the flight configuration are NOT_EVALUATED (27) or INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE (3); none is PASS.

**Evidence at bbc480c:**

- `docs/requirements/rvm_a9/rvm_a9_v1.json` #/status_counts/hall_icp_neutralizer
- `docs/requirements/rvm_a9/rvm_a9_v1.json` #/rows[id=RVM-21]
- `docs/experiments/hall_icp/programme/hw_programme_a9_21_v1.json` whole file (A9.21 items 6-11)
- `docs/decisions/OD_HARDWARE_PIVOT_2026_09_27.json` whole file (hardware-experiment pivot)

### RFP-P16-02 (p. 16, Part III 1(A)ii Figure 1) - COMPLY_PLANNED_WITH_EVIDENCE_PATH

> RFP (verbatim transcription): Logical Block Diagram: Intake -> Filter -> Compressor -> Gas Chamber -> Valve -> Thruster (Ionization zone | Acceleration zone) -> Thrust; Xenon Gas -> Valve -> Thruster.

**Response.** The proposed architecture follows the RFP logical block diagram: Intake (F1) -> Filter (F2) -> Compressor (F3) -> Gas Chamber / plenum (F4) -> Valve (atmospheric metering / isolation valve) -> Thruster (H-1 Hall accelerator: ionization zone and acceleration zone in one channel) -> Thrust; Xenon Gas -> Valve -> Thruster (separate Xe storage / flow path, AL-08). One element is ADDED outside the diagram: a downstream 13.56 MHz RF-ICP electron source / neutralizer (owner decisions A9, A9.19), which replaces a conventional hollow cathode. The upstream chain exists only as design-synthesis screening at bbc480c (INVESTIGATION_HYPOTHESIS), not as a frozen design.

### RFP-P17-02 (p. 17, Part III 1(A)iii) - NOT_YET_DEMONSTRATED

> RFP (verbatim transcription): List of critical technologies required for the solution: 1. Electric propulsion thruster to Ionize and accelerate N2 and nascent O. 2. Material compatibility to with stand VLEO atmospheric nascent oxygen. 3. Air Intake system design and compressor technology. 4. Test facility to simulate air mixture conditions in VLEO environment.

**Response.** Each listed critical technology is addressed, none is yet demonstrated: (1) thruster ionizing N2 and nascent O: Hall transport validation gate 3 is FAIL at bbc480c (credible transport set empty; P5-N2 v1 INCONCLUSIVE, permanent), the N2/N reaction set is complete only for its pre-registered domain, and the O/O2 chemistry v0 tables are DRAFT and unused; (2) AO material compatibility: AO / lifetime register v5 and the P4 anode-materials framework exist, every P4 gate is INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE, anode material OPEN; (3) intake and compressor: F1-F4 parametric screening only; (4) test facility simulating the VLEO air mixture: no facility record exists in the repository (OWNER_INPUT_REQUIRED, see 05_PROGRAMMATIC_SECTIONS.md).

### RFP-P17-03 (p. 17, Part III 1(A)iv row 1 Air Intake) - NOT_YET_DEMONSTRATED

> RFP (verbatim transcription): Air intake system captures residual atmospheric particles (mainly atomic oxygen and nitrogen) at VLEO altitudes (< 250 km). Most challenging in total system.

**Response.** Intake design is the subject of design-synthesis lane F1 (TPMC reduced-order intake model, Maxwell + CLL wall models, frozen NRLMSIS 2.1 atmosphere). At bbc480c the coupled upstream screen F7 is model-derived under PARAMETRIC_SENSITIVITY inputs: its nominal all-state delivered-flow frontier is 0.0983 mg/s and no Pareto member reaches the lower end (0.38 mg/s) of the characterization coverage at every state (F78-02; coverage, not a requirement). The post-freeze caveat in bid_technical_baseline.json applies: robust upstream closure must not be claimed from the bbc480c F7/F8 numbers (owner decision point R-03).

**Response.** Compressor and gas reservoir are covered by lanes F3 (compressor synthesis; Gaede / turbo characteristic) and F4 (plenum / feed). ### RFP-P17-05 (p. 17, Part III 1(A)iv row 3 Thruster) - NOT_YET_DEMONSTRATED

> RFP (verbatim transcription): Capability to ionize N2, atomic oxygen in same thruster and It should have capability to use Xe as propellant, an extra input system to take care any problems on board unforeseen problems.

**Response.** One H-1 Hall accelerator is proposed for atmospheric N2 / O-bearing propellant and Xe, with one downstream RF-ICP neutralizer serving both supply modes (A9.19). Xe capability is retained as the RFP's 'extra input system' (contingency / emergency supply mode; DISC-06 recorded). Not demonstrated: no Hall transport closure is admitted (gate 3 FAIL), O2-bearing ground tests are labelled NO_ATOMIC_O (atomic O only through the separate AO programme), and the Xe operation of the ICP is not yet measured (ICP-XE-MODE campaign planned).

### RFP-P18-01 (p. 18, Part III 1(A)iv row 4 Power System Electronics) - COMPLY_PLANNED_WITH_EVIDENCE_PATH

> RFP (verbatim transcription): Power system electronics shall capable taking power from satellite bus and provide the total ABEP system required voltages and Current requirements.

**Response.** A propulsion PPU taking power from the satellite bus and generating all ABEP supplies (Hall discharge, per-coil magnet supplies, 13.56 MHz RF generator + matching, ICP collector / bias, valve drivers, compressor drive, thermal control, housekeeping) is proposed. The bus-power boundary (A9-02) and preliminary PPU options (H2-4: LCC resonant or ZVS full-bridge discharge supply analogs) exist as PRELIMINARY_DRAFT_FOR_OWNER; the spacecraft-side input voltage is TBD (A902-12) and every load value is TBD. No PPU hardware exists.

### RFP-P18-06 (p. 18, Part III 2 Thrust Requirement) - NOT_YET_DEMONSTRATED

**Response.** No thrust value is offered from analysis: no Hall transport closure is admitted (credible set empty) and every absolute 0-D Hall result is withdrawn.
